title: Đề thi thử VSTEP — Review FTU HN 22/8/2026 (Viết + Nói)

questions.content:
writing — Task 1

You and your colleague John are organising a workshop next month to help employees perform more effectively at work. John has sent you a reminder email asking for your ideas. Write an email to John. In your email, you should: 1. suggest some topics for the workshop 2. say whether hands-on activities or group discussions would work better, and why 3. recommend who should be invited as the guest speaker

writing — Task 2

You should spend about 60 minutes on this task. Translation technology is becoming more and more advanced, and some people argue that it can replace the need to learn foreign languages. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of machine translation, and give your opinion on whether it can truly replace learning foreign languages. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write an essay of at least 250 words.

speaking — Part 1

In this first part, I'd like to ask you some questions about yourself. Let's talk about telling lies, and then about having a healthy diet.

speaking — Part 2

Situation: You order a meal at a restaurant, but the waiter brings you something different from what you ordered. You are considering the following options: 1. Politely asking the waiter to change the dish for you 2. Informing the restaurant and asking for your money back 3. Reporting the problem to the manager Which one would you choose? Why?

speaking — Part 3

Topic: More and more people record and share videos online every day. Talk about the benefits of sharing videos on the Internet. Ideas: - Earning money - Becoming famous - Connecting with others - Your own idea Further questions: 1. Why do many people want to share videos on the Internet? 2. How do you think video sharing will change in the future? 3. Are there any drawbacks to sharing videos online?
